about: The diagram Bouvet sent Leibniz in 1701, as one vertical terminal lesson of about 2 min. The user, 2026-09-30, with the woodcut: 'yes a nostromo style tutorial/raadout of this diagram!!! with flythrough and explations'. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-leibniz-diagram-design.md; facts: docs/research/2026-09-30-leibniz-diagram.md. The plate is fetched by scripts/leibniz-plate.mjs.
hexagramNote: the end card and its track come from 22, as in the Wang Bi lesson, so the two lessons end alike
style: The header reads 'SIX LINES // READY FOR INQUIRY' throughout. Each query clears the screen like a filmbook page. The query is typed after '>' (dim green); the answer types out below it (bright green, 48 px); the part of the readout the answer is about is drawn beside it, alone. Chapter pages: a single word, centred, held 2 s. Own names only, never MU/TH/UR or INTERFACE 2037.

music.why: calm, 90 bpm, long enough (197 s); pick14 (22's track) is 146 s

caption: The diagram of the 64 hexagrams that a Jesuit in Peking sent Leibniz in 1701, read as binary: Kun 0, Qian 63.

pages.a:
A DIAGRAM OF THE 64 HEXAGRAMS.
IT WENT FROM CHINA TO EUROPE IN 1701.

JOACHIM BOUVET, A JESUIT
AT THE KANGXI EMPEROR'S COURT.
PEKING, 4 NOVEMBER 1701.

GOTTFRIED LEIBNIZ, 1 APRIL 1703.
HE HAD WRITTEN UP BINARY IN 1679,
BEFORE HE SAW THIS.

pages.q: READ A LINE AS A BIT
pages.a:
BROKEN IS 0. SOLID IS 1.
READ FROM THE BOTTOM UP.

KUN, ALL BROKEN, IS 0.
QIAN, ALL SOLID, IS 63.

AT 31 THE RIGHT HALF IS FULL.
32 SETS THE BOTTOM LINE,
AND THE COUNT CLIMBS THE LEFT.

SHAO YONG 邵雍,
ELEVENTH CENTURY.

BY HALVING:
ONE, TWO, FOUR ... SIXTY-FOUR.
EACH SPLIT ADDS A LINE.

CHENG HAO 程顥:
"JUST THE DOUBLING METHOD."
加一倍法

THE SAME 64 AS A SQUARE.
EACH ROW SHARES ITS LOWER TRIGRAM,
EACH COLUMN ITS UPPER.

SHAO YONG ORDERED THE 64 BY HALVING.
HE DID NO SUMS WITH THEM.
LEIBNIZ SAW CONFIRMATION, NOT A SOURCE.

WANG BI, 800 YEARS EARLIER:
ONCE YOU HAVE THE MEANING,
FORGET THE IMAGE.
